svg.font-family: Consolas, Menlo, "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Courier New", monospace
svg.text: > fit <- model(y ~ cg + animal(id), d2, ped) # two records per animal

g.text: Warning: animal(id): 200 of the 200 animals with records of y have more than one record
(400 records between them) and the model has no pe(id): the permanent-environment
covariance between records of the same animal goes into var(animal), which inflates h2 by
more the larger the share of repeated records; add pe(id), the repeatability model
